title: Projection and rounding inner product
statement: Let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$ and let $J\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$. For each input $x$, let $P_Jf(x)$ be the average of $f$ over inputs that agree with $x$ on $J$, and let $R_Jf(x)$ be $1$ when $P_Jf(x)\geq0$ and $−1$ otherwise. Then the uniform inner product of $P_Jf$ with $R_Jf$ equals the uniform average of $|P_Jf|$ over the cube.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a subset of the coordinates
